reviews.comment: Dr. Falzarano is a great professor. I have currently taken 2 courses with him and will be taking a third this upcoming semester. He cares more about you actually learning something from his course than anything else. He is exam heavy but as long as you show up to lectures and pay attention you will pass no problem what so ever.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Falzarano is a great professor, I have had him for 3 different classes now and I only wish that I could have taken more with him. If you participate in class you will pass, he cares about his students more than any other professor that I have had before. He is a great guy!
